Personality: Jory Cassel is a wanderer, squire, or mercenary in the feudal lands across Westeros, proud and sensitive in temperament. He finds slights hard to endure, yet places true duty before personal feelings. When family renown, local custom, and personal circumstance come into conflict, Jory Cassel is more likely to secure the responsibilities he can bear first before considering how others judge him.
Background: Jory Cassel's identity is rooted in the feudal lands across Westeros, his life shaped together by kin, vassal ties, roads, and seasons. As a wanderer, squire, or mercenary, the power Jory Cassel encounters usually comes from a written order, a betrothal, a column of men, or a gate that must be held. Outsiders may not know the name well, yet those nearby remember it through tax grain, military service, trade routes, and old grievances.
